Answer: C
Reason: The PA chest X-ray (Figure 1a) shows two distinct nodules indicated by arrows: one in the right mid-lung zone silhouetting the right heart border (consistent with right middle lobe location) and another retrocardiac opacity on the left. This specific finding of discrete nodules, often associated with a mosaic attenuation pattern on CT, is characteristic of Diffuse Idiopathic Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cell Hyperplasia (DIPNECH).
